scripts.gen:ket: node scripts/build-data.mjs ket && node scripts/build-app.mjs ket
scripts.gen:pet: node scripts/build-data.mjs pet && node scripts/build-app.mjs pet
scripts.dev:ket: node scripts/build-data.mjs ket && node scripts/build-app.mjs ket && VITE_APP_ID=ket vite
scripts.dev:pet: node scripts/build-data.mjs pet && node scripts/build-app.mjs pet && VITE_APP_ID=pet vite
scripts.build:ket: node scripts/build-data.mjs ket && node scripts/build-app.mjs ket && python3 scripts/make-icons.py KET && VITE_APP_ID=ket vite build --outDir dist/ket
scripts.build:pet: node scripts/build-data.mjs pet && node scripts/build-app.mjs pet && python3 scripts/make-icons.py PET && VITE_APP_ID=pet vite build --outDir dist/pet
